get.description:
Admin-only, newest-first, bounded page of audit rows (team-scoped).

Scope rule: rows bound to the principal's team members, PLUS unbound
rows (denials of non-members — the common denied case) whose ``detail``
names the principal's team. Rows of other teams are never returned.

schema.title: Response List Audit Api V1 Audit Get

get.description:
Admin-only evidence export for the CALLER's team (there is no team parameter, so a
foreign team's rows can never be requested). ``stream=audit`` is the security audit
log; ``stream=collab`` is the product event history of shared runs (optionally one
``runId``). Ascending by ``seq`` from ``afterSeq``; at most EXPORT_PAGE_MAX rows per
call; follow ``nextCursor`` while ``hasMore``. Each export is itself audited.

schema.title: Response Export Audit Api V1 Audit Export Get

post.description: Accept a browser CSP violation report (204, no content).

An authed user redeems a token into the invited team at the invited
role — M18-C5 (MAC2-F3): ONLY after presenting the invited ``email``.

Validate-first, then atomic single-statement claim: the identity gate runs
BEFORE any mutation, so a wrong/missing identity never consumes a live
token (no DoS-by-forwarding, no poisoned audit trail). The claim itself
keeps the exact historical WHERE clause (expired/redeemed/unknown answer
honest codes; concurrent redemptions cannot double-join), and a lost race
re-runs the diagnosis once so the caller hears the true reason.

schema.title: Response Redeem Invite Api V1 Invites Redeem Post

get.description:
List the caller's team keys (hint only, never the raw key).

?teamId= is honored only when it matches the caller's membership —
anything else answers 404 NOT_FOUND, identical to an unknown team id
(M13-G5a no-oracle law; was 403 FORBIDDEN).

404.description: teamId does not match the caller's membership (no-oracle)

post.description: Store a BYO provider key for the caller's team, encrypted at rest.

404.description: unknown id OR another team's key (no-oracle)

get.description:
M14-F2a — full invite lifecycle list for the admin UI.

Every status is returned (draft/sent/redeemed/expired/revoked derived per
invite via _invite_status); ``?status=<s>`` narrows to one bucket. The old
pending-only behavior stays available as ``?status=sent``.

Admin-only: any other caller (foreign OR in-team non-admin) gets 404/403
without leaking whether any invites exist (enumeration guard, M13-G5a).

schema.title: Response List Invites Api V1 Teams  Team Id  Invites Get

post.description: Admin-only: mint an invite. The raw token appears exactly once, here.

schema.title: Response Create Invite Api V1 Teams  Team Id  Invites Post

delete.description:
M14-F2a — admin-only revoke. The row is KEPT (revoked_at stamped) so the
lifecycle list can show "revoked" and audit rows keep a real target; the
token dies either way. Revoking an already-terminal invite is idempotent.

schema.title: Response Revoke Invite Api V1 Teams  Team Id  Invites  Invite Id  Delete

post.description:
M14-F2a — admin-only resend: mint a fresh token for the SAME invite and
revoke the old one in ONE transaction. An intercepted stale token dies the
moment a fresh one is issued. Only live invites can be resent — redeemed,
expired, revoked or draft-less rows answer honest 409/410 codes.

schema.title: Response Resend Invite Api V1 Teams  Team Id  Invites  Invite Id  Resend Post

post.description:
Mint a one-time, 30s, project-bound ticket so the WS upgrade never needs
a long-lived bearer token in a URL (H8). M15-W5-S2: the ticket is also
bound to this client's fingerprint (UA + peer IP hash) and only upgrades
from a request that reproduces it.
